image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a grey whale's back and dorsal area surfacing in greenish water. The skin is dark grey with significant white mottling and barnacle clusters (callosities). A distinct longitudinal groove or fold runs along the side of the body. Part of a yellow object (likely a kayak or boat) is visible in the bottom left corner.
